title: Algebraization from torsion in the completed conormal differential
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Put $P=A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]^\wedge$ for some integer $r\geq0$, where completion is $I$-adic [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $J\subseteq P$ be an ideal and let $E=P/J$ be $I$-adically complete. Suppose that, for some $c\geq0$, $I^c$ annihilates the kernel and cokernel of $\delta:J/J^2\to E^{\oplus r}$, $f\bmod J^2\mapsto(\partial f/\partial x_i\bmod J)_{i=1}^r$, using the continuous polynomial derivatives on $P$. Then there is a finite type commutative $A$-algebra $D$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] such that $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale over $\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus V(I)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-etale-morphism], together with an $A$-algebra isomorphism $D^\wedge\cong E$ of $I$-adic completions.
